name: Park Hyatt Busan
positioning: Park Hyatt hotel in Haeundae, Busan, with views of the ocean and Gwangan Bridge
best_for: Travelers who want ocean and Gwangan Bridge views
Visitors to the Busan Exhibition and Convention Center (BEXCO)
Families wanting a suite designed for families

facts.text: Park Hyatt Busan is in Haeundae, Busan, with views of the ocean and Gwangan Bridge.
The hotel sits alongside shopping malls and the Busan Exhibition and Convention Center (BEXCO).
Bathrooms have rain showers and bathtubs with custom Le Labo products.
Family Ocean Suites are designed specifically for families.
Dining Room also prepares Korean cuisine reinterpreted in Park Hyatt style.
Living Room is an Italian restaurant on the 31st floor serving traditional Italian comfort food.
Living Room Bar holds a Champagne & Jazz Night on the last Friday of each month.
Ocelas Spa has treatment rooms designed for couples.
The hotel has a granite indoor swimming pool.
The fitness center has a private studio for personal training.

highlights.text: In the Marina Ocean Corner Suites, the king bed sits at the corner of the floor-to-ceiling windows, with sunsets behind Gwangan Bridge.
Dining Room is the hotel's steak and seafood grill on the 32nd floor, with open kitchens and an open charcoal grill.
The pool and sauna area has views of Gwangan Bridge at night.
Living Room Bar is on the 31st floor with a view of Gwangan Bridge.
Patisserie, the hotel's pastry boutique at the entrance, serves homemade European pastries, chocolates and pralines.

considerations.text: Gimhae International Airport (PUS) is 25 kilometers from the hotel.
Hotel limousines to and from the airport must be reserved in advance.
WhataHotel notes premium pricing and limited availability during peak seasons.
